question: A woman with coronary artery disease is starting to go for a walk. As she begins, her heart rate accelerates from a resting pulse of 60 bpm until it reaches a rate of 120 bpm, at which point she begins to feel a tightening in her chest. She stops walking to rest and the tightening resolves. This has been happening to her consistently for the last 6 months. Which of the following is a true statement?

options.opa: Increasing the heart rate increases the amount of time spent during each cardiac cycle
options.opb: Increasing the heart rate decreases the relative amount of time spent during diastole
options.opc: Perfusion of the myocardium takes place primarily during systole
options.opd: Perfusion of the myocardium takes place equally throughout the cardiac cycle
options.ope: This patient's chest pain is indicative of transmural ischemia
